description: List one record's files: its file indexes (groups of up to ~1,500 files) with their XRootD URI-list URLs, and per file the XRootD URI, HTTPS download URL, size, adler32 checksum and availability. Without index, returns the record's indexes and its regular files; with index, reads only that index and pages through its files. Files marked on demand sit on tape and must be requested on the record's portal page before download.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, unchanged, with the same recid and index. Omit for the first page.

index.description: A file index key from the indexes list, matched exactly (a .txt ending is read as .json). Omit to list the record's indexes and regular files.

recid.description: Record id: up to 12 digits (6004), optionally after an experiment prefix (atlas-160006); recid:6004 or a portal record URL also work. cern_opendata_search_records and cern_opendata_get_records return it.

name: cern_opendata_list_files

availability.description: Record-level availability: online, partial, ondemand or requested.

availability_details.description: File counts by availability state for the whole record.

on_demand.description: Files on tape, requested on the record's portal page before download.

cap.description: The page size (limit) applied to this call.

children.description: Set only for an umbrella record holding no files itself: the child recids whose files make it up. Empty otherwise.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `record_not_found`: No record has this recid: the portal answered 404 for the record, or, with index set, for the index while the record search found nothing. `index_not_found`: index names no file index of this record: the portal answered 404 for it while the record exists, the record lists no such key, or the key is ., .. or not well-formed Unicode. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode, was issued for another recid or index, or points past the end. `rate_limited`: The portal's 60-a-minute budget is spent: it answered 429, or the request could not start within the call's deadline. data.retryAfter is set. `upstream_unreadable`: The portal answered with a body the server could not read: not JSON, missing the expected envelope, a file without its XRootD URI or size, a file index whose key is missing or cannot be URL-encoded, or over the byte ceiling (then data.retryable is false); or the record search answered 404. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

files.description: This page of files: regular files in record scope, the index's files in index scope.

availability.description: online, or on demand (on tape; request it on the record page first).

filename.description: Real file name, for index members.

https_url.description: HTTPS download URL on the portal: the record's files route for a keyed file, the /eos/opendata/ route for a keyless one. Absent when a keyless file's XRootD URI is not a file path under eospublic.cern.ch/eos/opendata/, or when the key or path holds a lone surrogate or an empty, . or .. segment.

key.description: File key as the portal states it; index members read <index>.json_<n>. Absent when the portal lists the file without one; filename then names it.

has_more.description: True when more files remain past this page.

indexes.description: Every file index in record scope; only the selected one in index scope.

items.description: One file index (a group of files).

availability.description: File counts by availability state, as the portal states them; empty ({}) when it states none.

on_demand.description: Files on tape, requested on the record's portal page before download.

description.description: Index description as the portal states it.

json_url.description: The index entry with its files, as JSON.

key.description: Index key (…_file_index.json, or a name such as training_files.json); pass it as index to page its files.

number_files.description: Files in the index, as the portal states it, else the count of the files the index lists.

size_in_bytes.description: Total size of the index files in bytes, as the portal states it, else the sum of the listed files' sizes.

uri_list_url.description: Plain-text list of every XRootD URI in the index, one per line.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same recid and index, for the next page.

notice.description: Guidance for the next call: how to page on, why nothing matched and what to change, or a caveat about the results.

portal_url.description: The record page, where on-demand (tape) files are requested.

scope.description: record: the record's indexes and regular files; index: one index's files.

shown.description: Number of items returned on this page.

totalCount.description: Files in scope: regular files in record scope, index files in index scope.

truncated.description: True when more results remain past this page; notice says how to reach them.

title: List CERN Open Data Record Files
